description.value:
Has no physical body. Nonmagical attacks cannot harm it; corporeal magical sources normally have a 50% failure chance except for force, positive or negative energy, ghost touch, and other stated exceptions. It uses a Charisma-based deflection bonus, can pass through objects under the printed limits, moves silently, cannot fall or make physical trip or grapple attacks, and follows the full incorporeal combat rules.

This reusable record defines shared conversion behavior. Individual actors carry exact printed exceptions and totals.

system.source: World of Warcraft: Monster Guide, pp. 191-192
